title: Servers above average active-session count
description: Count active sessions for every server, including servers with zero active sessions, and include those zero counts when calculating the average across all servers. Return exactly two columns: hostname, active_sessions only for servers whose active_sessions is strictly above that average. Use a CTE. Sort by active_sessions DESC, then hostname ASC for ties.
starter_sql:
WITH session_counts AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.hostname
    FROM servers AS s
)
hints: Count active sessions in the CTE with LEFT JOIN so zero-session servers remain.
Calculate the average from the completed counts in the CTE.
solution_explanation: The CTE first builds a complete server/count set; the outer query compares each count with that set average.
